Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
2 servings
8 oz spaghetti
1/3 cup olive oil
6 garlic cloves, thinly sliced
1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes
1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
salt to taste
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti until al dente, about 9 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook until the garlic is golden, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the drained spaghetti to the skillet with a splash of the reserved pasta water and toss to coat. Stir in the parsley and Parmesan, season with salt and serve.
